item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Merge paragraph versions instead of complete documents","mechanism":"A causal multi-value register preserves concurrent paragraph edits, including their original text and authorship.","implementation":"Persist operations locally with paragraph ID, device/counter ID, two-device causal vector, and text. Exchange missing operations through existing synchronization; retain concurrent versions.","check":"Edit different paragraphs offline, then the same paragraph. Both reconnect orders must preserve independent changes and identical conflicting texts with author labels.","risk":"Logical revision ordering alone cannot distinguish concurrency; persist causal counters reliably."},{"action":"Synchronize paragraph ordering separately from paragraph text","mechanism":"Stable position keys separate moves from prose edits; deterministic tie-breaking handles simultaneous moves.","implementation":"Store moves as causal operations containing paragraph ID and a position key between neighbors. Select concurrent move winners by operation ID; sort ties by paragraph ID.","check":"Replay simultaneous moves and text edits in reversed delivery orders. Assert identical paragraph order, one occurrence per paragraph, and unchanged retained text versions.","risk":"Concurrent placement intent may lose; position keys can grow."},{"action":"Keep deletion conflicts until explicit user resolution","mechanism":"Tombstones make deletion an attributable competing version, rather than erasing a concurrent edit.","implementation":"Retain deleted text and conflicting edits. Show author/device labels and deletion status; record resolutions referencing all displayed version IDs. An unseen concurrent version remains unresolved.","check":"Delete a paragraph offline on one device and edit it on the other. Both reconnect orders must show deletion versus intact edited text.","risk":"Premature tombstone cleanup can resurrect paragraphs; avoid time-only expiration."},{"action":"Add deterministic offline replay regression tests","mechanism":"A seeded operation-log harness checks convergence and preservation independently of arrival order.","implementation":"From a shared baseline, script independent edits, competing edits, moves, deletion versus edit, and resolution. Replay both reconnect orders with duplicates, delayed operations, and restart boundaries.","check":"Assert equal canonical states, retained unresolved source texts and authors, and no lost independent edits. Repeat at 500 paragraphs with 8 KB text.","risk":"Finite replay cases cannot prove correctness; retain failing seeds as regressions."}],"abstention_reason":""}
